profile.name: Krishnendu Kander
profile.tagline: Document AI researcher exploring how machines understand the world's documents — and a curious human who loves books, travel and good coffee.

content.tags: AI Researcher · Keynote Speaker · Author · Document AI · Open Source · Educator · Innovator
content.about: I'm a researcher in Document AI and Visual Document Analysis. I love turning messy real-world documents into something machines can truly understand. Beyond research, I'm a reader of philosophy and sci-fi, an explorer of new cities, and someone who believes the best ideas come over a cup of coffee.
content.researchBody: My research focuses on building robust, efficient systems for document understanding — spanning privacy-preserving NLP, multilingual information retrieval, and benchmarking methodologies for new datasets.
content.nowText: Right now I'm deep into document understanding research, reading about systems thinking, and always open to collaborating on interesting problems. Reach out anytime.
